import ctypes
import os

# Load the libraries in the correct order
ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so", mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so")

# Define the gsl_rng structure
class gsl_rng(ctypes.Structure):
    pass

gsl.gsl_rng_alloc.restype = ctypes.POINTER(gsl_rng)
gsl.gsl_rng_alloc.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p]

gsl.gsl_rng_set.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(gsl_rng), ctypes.c_ulong]

gsl.gsl_rng_get.restype = ctypes.c_ulong
gsl.gsl_rng_get.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(gsl_rng)]

gsl.gsl_rng_free.argtypes = [ctypes.POINTER(gsl_rng)]

# Load the gsl_rng_type for gsl_rng_knuthran2002
gsl.gsl_rng_knuthran2002 = ctypes.c_void_p.in_dll(gsl, "gsl_rng_knuthran2002")

# Function to generate random numbers
def generate_random_numbers(seed, count):
    # Allocate the RNG
    rng = gsl.gsl_rng_alloc(gsl.gsl_rng_knuthran2002)
    if not rng:
        raise MemoryError("Failed to allocate memory for the RNG.")

    try:
        # Initialize the RNG with the seed
        gsl.gsl_rng_set(rng, seed)

        # Generate random numbers
        random_numbers = []
        for _ in range(count):
            random_number = gsl.gsl_rng_get(rng)
            random_numbers.append(random_number)

        return random_numbers
    finally:
        # Free the RNG
        gsl.gsl_rng_free(rng)

# Assertion tests
def assert_test():
    # Test with seed 42 and generate 5 random numbers
    seed = 42
    count = 5
    random_numbers = generate_random_numbers(seed, count)
    assert len(random_numbers) == count, "Incorrect number of random numbers generated"
    assert all(isinstance(num, int) for num in random_numbers), "Generated values are not integers"

    # Test with a different seed
    seed = 12345
    count = 10
    random_numbers = generate_random_numbers(seed, count)
    assert len(random_numbers) == count, "Incorrect number of random numbers generated"
    assert all(isinstance(num, int) for num in random_numbers), "Generated values are not integers"

    print("All tests passed.")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert_test()
